human_hints.title: Build like
human_hints.summary: Snares duplicating time (rising) to pace up the chorus energy, similar to a drop (not a drop, but main chorus)

human_hints.title: Drums cut
human_hints.summary: All drums stop dead for ~5 beats after the snare run — the highest-tension moment of the passage. Only a single pickup snare at 127.195 breaks it, 75 ms before the chorus downbeat.

human_hints.title: Late impact
human_hints.summary: The chorus downbeat is not the payoff: it opens as a build (hats ramp eighth to sixteenth, snares nearly absent). The real impact lands at 131.1, about two bars late. Do not peak the show at 127.27.

human_hints.title: Kick doubles
human_hints.summary: Bar 79 loads the transition: the kick goes quarter to eighth (156.059 / 156.300 / 156.541), and three crashes land on beat 3 at 156.659-156.902 — the first crashes in 30 seconds. Snares run the bar out at 157.27 and 157.52.

human_hints.title: Late impact
human_hints.summary: Same trap as 127.27, half a second wide: the section boundary is not the payoff. gesture-045's tension resolves at 158.45, the peak hit (kick+snare+crash together) is at 158.841, and a sustained crash wash follows. Drums enter at 157.25 for the rest of the song and vocals drop out entirely.
